apps.localizedDescription: Raise, care for, and explore with your voxel companion. Play minigames, earn coins, discover hideouts, and care for your pet on iPhone.

versions.localizedDescription:
Kinbits 1.1 Beta 5

Fixes:
- Go Outside now works right after feeding, cleaning, playing a game or calming a tantrum. Before, it could quietly refuse for a short while.
- If your Kinbit can't go Outside right now, the screen now tells you why (for example, it's asleep, at work, or needs care).

Update over your existing Kinbits installation to preserve your pet. When SideStore asks about app extensions, choose "Keep App Extensions" so the widget stays available.

Kinbits 1.1 Beta 4

Changes:
- Even without meeting another player, your Kinbit sometimes brings a new friend home from Outside. After a normal trip there's a 50% chance a wandering Kinbit comes to visit once you've read the trip story.
- These wandering visitors hang out just like other visitors, and each one leaves you a gift of 10 to 50 coins.
- Their owner is unknown, so the Visitor Log shows them as "???".
- Meeting a real player's Kinbit always takes priority, and calling your Kinbit home early with Return Now never brings a visitor.

Update over your existing Kinbits installation to preserve your pet. When SideStore asks about app extensions, choose "Keep App Extensions" so the widget stays available.

Kinbits 1.1 Beta 3

Changes:
- Nearby visitors (beta): when your Kinbit meets another player's Kinbit while Outside, that Kinbit comes to visit once your Kinbit is home and free.
- They hang out together for about 10 minutes, with little greetings, hops, dances and chats.
- If the other player wrote a message before their trip, you can read it from More during the visit.
- Ask to Leave ends a visit early with a proper goodbye.
- The first time you meet a new player's Kinbit, it leaves you a small coin gift (10 to 50 coins). Meeting the same Kinbit again later is still a visit, just without another gift.
- New Visitor Log in More: every Kinbit you've met, with their owner's name, when you met, and any message they carried.
- The Home Screen widget shows when you have a visitor. Tap it to see them in the app.

Nearby encounters are still being tested on real phones, so meetings may not happen every time.

Update over your existing Kinbits installation to preserve your pet. When SideStore asks about app extensions, choose "Keep App Extensions" so the widget stays available.

Kinbits 1.1 Beta 2

Changes:
- Outside requests now sound like your Kinbit: each personality asks to go Outside in its own way.
- A notification lets you know when your Kinbit wants to go Outside. Open Kinbits to answer.
- Before a trip, you can give your Kinbit a short message to carry (optional, one line, up to 80 characters). You can always skip it.
- New (beta): Nearby Kinbit Encounters. While your Kinbit is Outside, it may meet another player's Kinbit on a nearby phone, on iPhone or Android. Both phones need Kinbits open or recently used with a Kinbit Outside, and Bluetooth on. Meetings are saved for a future update; this beta only lets you know a meeting happened.
- Settings > Nearby Kinbit Encounters turns this on or off. Outside works exactly the same either way.
- Only your Kinbit's look, name, your owner name and the optional message are shared with the other phone. No location, no account, no contact details.

This feature is new and still being tested on real phones, so meetings may not happen every time.

Update over your existing Kinbits installation to preserve your pet. When SideStore asks about app extensions, choose "Keep App Extensions" so the widget stays available.

Kinbits 1.1 Beta 1

Changes:
- Your Kinbit can now call you by name. After updating, you'll be asked once: "What should your Kinbit call you?" Your pet, progress, diary and family are kept exactly as they were.
- Change your name any time in Settings > Owner Name.
- Every now and then your Kinbit says something to you by name: hellos, warmer words when you're close, good nights before bed, and happy reunions after trips Outside or work.
- Kinbit age: Pet Info now shows how old your Kinbit is (one real day = one Kinbit year).
- Pet Info redesign: your Kinbit's name up top, then personality, stage, age, next stage, blessing and coins, with the condition bars grouped together.
- The Home Screen widget sometimes greets you by name too.

Your name stays on your device.

Update over your existing Kinbits installation to preserve your pet. When SideStore asks about app extensions, choose "Keep App Extensions" so the widget stays available.

Changes:
- New Home Screen widget design: see your Kinbit in its room, a friendly line about what it's up to right now (visitors, trips Outside, work, bedtime, diary time, needs and moods), and its Hunger, Energy, Joy and Clean levels.
- The widget updates through the day, and your Kinbit changes pose every so often.
- Tap anywhere on the widget to open Kinbits.

Update over your existing Kinbits installation to preserve your pet.

Changes:
- New head shapes: Kinbits now have ten blockier, toy-like heads, including a tall squircle, a wide block, a trapezoid, a monitor, a faceted block, a stacked cube, a side-step block and a mushroom cap.
- Your Kinbit, its family and its lineage keep their identity and voice; only the look of the head is new.

Update over your existing Kinbits installation to preserve your pet.

Changes:
- The Kinbits Home Screen widget is now included in the regular download. Long-press your Home Screen, tap Edit > Add Widget, and choose Kinbits.
- The widget looks like the game screen: your Kinbit in its room, with the Feed, Play, Care and More buttons. Your Kinbit changes pose about once a minute.
- The widget follows your own sleep schedule.
- Anything you do from the widget is kept when you open the app.

If SideStore asks about app extensions while installing, choose "Keep App Extensions (Register App ID for Each Extension)" to get the widget.

Update over your existing Kinbits installation to preserve your pet.

Changes:
- Diary entries now describe what your Kinbit actually did that day (meals, baths, games, trips Outside, work, visits, getting sick and recovering, and more), written in its own personality's voice.
- New eye styles: most Kinbits now have cute robotic eyes (inset blocks, little screens, pixel eyes and a visor). The purple full-circle and blue half-closed eyes stay. Every Kinbit keeps its own eye type, and all expressions still show.

Diary entries written before this update stay as they were.

Update over your existing Kinbits installation to preserve your pet.

Fixes:
- A sleeping Kinbit can no longer be disturbed: tapping the screen while it sleeps does nothing.
- In the last hour before wake-up time a Wake button appears, so you can wake your Kinbit early.
- In the hour before bedtime your Kinbit writes in its diary when it has nothing else to do. Feed, Play, Care, More and tapping all still work, and it goes back to writing once you let it be.
- The early Sleep button is gone; your Kinbit falls asleep on its own at bedtime.

Update over your existing Kinbits installation to preserve your pet.

Fixes:
- Play > Go Outside works again: your Kinbit heads out, you can call it home early, and it comes back with a story and a small find.
- Parent visit stories are always fully readable.
- The Family Tree now shows both parents and your current Kinbit as real pictures.
- Pet Info shows colored meter bars for Hunger, Energy, Joy, Bond and Hygiene.
- The More, Shop, Inventory and game menus use the proper icons, and their buttons are bigger and easier to tap.

Update over your existing Kinbits installation to preserve your pet.

Fixes:
- Your Kinbit's face now matches how it really feels. A happy, healthy Kinbit no longer looks angry.
- Tantrums now work: your Kinbit makes a racket and you can calm it down with one tap.
- Marriage visitors now arrive, can be answered Yes or No, and leave when their time runs out.
- Parents visit, small life moments, greetings, Outside trips, job offers, work days and farewells now appear on screen.
- Hatching and growing up play their bright reveal again.
- Tap the screen during an animation to skip it and keep playing right away.
- Babies only see Guess the Direction; the other games unlock as an Adult.
- Perfect Timing: the marker now moves across the bar, and you stop it yourself.
- Guess the Direction keeps your Kinbit on screen; the other games use the whole screen.
- Food reaction messages now disappear on their own.

Update over your existing Kinbits installation to preserve your pet.

Kinbits 1.0 Beta 6

Fixes:
- Your Kinbit now really moves: idle walks, hops, turns, looks and accessory performances play as smooth animations.
- Feeding, Baby Milk, cleaning, medicine, taps and other actions play their full animations and settle back on their own.
- Every Kinbit has its own voice again, with chirps that match how it is feeling.
- When your Kinbit is sick, a single Medicine button replaces the main controls.
- Your Kinbit stays on screen during minigames and reacts to the result: happy when you win, sad when you lose.
- Guess the Direction: your Kinbit walks the way it actually chose.

Update over your existing Kinbits installation to preserve your pet.

Kinbits 1.0 Beta 5

Fixes:
- Restored screen effects.
- Improved Shop and Inventory equipment flow.
- Added equipment reveal transitions.
- Restored pet-scene tap interactions.
- Restored random idle and action animations.
- Fixed Baby Milk presentation timing.
- Expanded Developer Settings parity.

Kinbits 1.0 Beta 4

Fixes:
- Corrected Back and Exit controls across in-game pages.
- Fixed navigation between More, Shop, Inventory, Pet Info, Diary, and Family Tree.
- Repaired Settings interactions and layout.
- Fixed custom sleep schedules.
- Fixed notification management.
- Fixed the secret Developer Settings unlock.
- Improved sound-setting behavior and persistence.

Update over your existing Kinbits installation to preserve your pet.

Fixes:
- Restored action animations and sleeping presentation.
- Fixed GAME SCREEN controls overlapping outer navigation.
- Restored the full More page, Shop, and Inventory.
- Restored the secret Developer Settings unlock.
- Removed an obsolete Care menu and restored direct care behavior.
- Stabilized the FAQ featured carousel layout.

Update over your existing installation to preserve your Kinbit.

Fixes:
- Fixed Egg lifecycle progression on physical iPhones.
- Restored Egg status and scene presentation.
- Restored missing visual content on app pages.
- Improved physical-device gameplay reliability.

Please update over your existing installation. Do not delete Kinbits first if you want to preserve your pet.
Initial private beta test release for Kinbits iOS 1.0.
